# TPC-Havoc Q13_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  c_count,
  COUNT(*) AS custdist
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS c_count
  FROM customer AS c
  LEFT OUTER JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey AND NOT o.o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%'
  GROUP BY
    c.c_custkey
) AS c_orders(c_custkey, c_count)
GROUP BY
  c_count
ORDER BY
  custdist DESC,
  c_count DESC
```
